title: fix(app-shell,cli,plugin-designer): one authority for Diagnostic, DiagnosticLevel and ConfirmDialogState (objectui#6349, batch 6)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 6)

Clause-②: yes

Batch 6 of the one-authority burn-down, on claim `6080168957` (seat `domain:ui#3`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`). Three rows of `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` converge. Each row was two or three meanings behind one name, and each converges by renaming the sites that no package entry publishes. Types and comments only: no runtime behaviour changes, and no emitted JavaScript changes.

This PR has no closing keyword. The card stays open for later batches.

## What each row was (measured on base `3fd86251`)

**`Diagnostic`: three meanings.**

| site | members | meaning | built entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts` | `severity`, `code`, `message`, `start?`, `tag?` | a parser finding | exported at the root; read through it by `@object-ui/components`' `page.tsx` and 17 test files (single-line import clauses; control `SchemaElement`: 20) |
| `packages/app-shell/.../simulator/flow-sim-types.ts` | `level`, `nodeId?`, `edge?`, `message`, `cycle?` | a flow structural-check finding | not exported, and reached by no root export |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` | `level`, `message`, `id` | an `objectui doctor` check result | not exported (the entry exports `serve` and `init` only) |

The three share only `message`. sdui-parser keeps the name. The flow site becomes `FlowSimDiagnostic`; the doctor site becomes `DoctorDiagnostic`.

**`DiagnosticLevel`: two meanings.** The flow site is `'error' | 'warning'`, a severity. The doctor site is `'ok' | 'warn' | 'error'`, a check verdict with an `ok` arm. They share only `'error'`. Neither is exported. The flow designer's keeps the name: `flow-problems.ts` puts it on structural, server and expression problems alike, so it is the designer's general level, not the simulator's. The doctor's becomes `DoctorDiagnosticLevel`.

**`ConfirmDialogState`: two meanings.** app-shell's (`ActionConfirmDialog.tsx`) has `open`, `message`, `options?` and `resolve?`. It is the data the action-confirm dialog renders, with the promise's resolver. The designer's (`useConfirmDialog.ts`) has `isOpen`, `title`, `message`, `confirm`, `onConfirm` and `onCancel`. It is a hook result. They share only `message`. Neither built entry exports the name. The designer's becomes `DesignerConfirmDialogState`, following `DesignerHistoryState`. That rename touches 2 files (the declaration and the `hooks/index.ts` re-export), where the app-shell side would touch 4.

**Why renames and not a re-point.** By batch 3's rule, only a dependency-legal direction may re-point. Neither app-shell nor cli depends on `@object-ui/sdui-parser`. app-shell does reach plugin-designer as a peer, but the designer's shape means something else. So the remedy is the card's rename branch, under the batch 5 amendment `6078948754`: two meanings, so rename the narrower side; and a site no built entry reaches publishes nothing.

## Published surface, base vs head

One TypeScript program per tree over each package's built root entry (`exports["."].types`), with dist rebuilt for each tree:

- **Exported name sets.** app-shell 258 = 258, cli 2 = 2, sdui-parser 41 = 41, plugin-designer 38 = 38. That is 0 diff lines for every package. plugin-chatbot has 93 names at head.
- **Structural reach.** A walker follows every root export through members, signatures, type arguments and unions. It reaches the designer interface only as the return type of `useConfirmDialog`, which cannot be named from the entry. It reaches no flow-sim site and no doctor site. The walker is lit: it reaches 152 app-shell types that are not exported, `ObjectActionConfig` (through `useObjectActions`) among them.
- **Emitted output.** Base and head dist differ only in declaration files and maps:
  - plugin-designer: `hooks/useConfirmDialog.d.ts`, `hooks/index.d.ts`;
  - app-shell: `flow-sim-types.d.ts`, `flow-sim-validate.d.ts`;
  - plugin-chatbot: `chatMessageAdapter.d.ts`, a JSDoc change;
  - cli: `cli.js.map`, whose `sourcesContent` changed.

  No `.js` file differs in any of the five packages. So no first-load bytes move.

## Riders (comment-only)

- `AiChatPage.tsx`: the import comment no longer calls `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` "a deprecated alias" and no longer tells new code to spell `ChatMessage`. It now says what batch 5 made true: `ChatbotEnhancedMessage` is the runtime contract's one name, and the plugin root publishes no `ChatMessage`.
- `useObjectChat.ts` and `chatMessageAdapter.ts`: `ChatbotEnhanced.ChatMessage` is now `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`.
- The ledger's note above the Filter rows now records that objectui#7561 and objectui#9306 are no longer open. It records that ruling `5857342228` (objectui#9306, letter A) landed as objectui#10823, so components derives both types from `@object-ui/types`, keeping `operator` and `value` as named extensions. The rows stay until a batch measures a rename against that ruling. The rows themselves are untouched.

| `6349-batch6-plugin-designer.md` | `minor` | A type name inside its published declarations moves (`useConfirmDialog` now returns `DesignerConfirmDialogState`). Breaking-change note: nothing breaks, because the old name was never importable from the entry. |
| `6349-batch6-app-shell.md` | `patch` | Internal rename and a comment. The entry exports neither name. |
| `6349-batch6-cli.md` | `patch` | Internal rename. The entry exports `serve` and `init` only. |
| `6349-batch6-plugin-chatbot.md` | `patch` | Doc comments only. |

The grades follow the claim's criterion: `minor` where a published shape widens or a name moves. ⛔ No `major`.

## Reverse verification

Every leg went through `ablation-replace` in wrap mode. Predictions were written before any leg ran. Each leg was restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| leg | mutation | result (as predicted) |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `ConfirmDialogState` row put back | `Tests 1 failed / 10 passed`, `no longer collides at:` lists both files |
| S2 | `Diagnostic` row put back | same verdict; lists all three files |
| S3 | `DiagnosticLevel` row put back | same verdict; lists both files |
| F1 | designer `hooks/index.ts` aliases `DesignerConfirmDialogState as ConfirmDialogState` | `ConfirmDialogState — a NEW colliding name`: `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` (interface declaration) and `hooks/index.ts` (aliasing re-export) |
| F2 | flow-sim declares `Diagnostic` again | `Diagnostic — a NEW colliding name`: `flow-sim-types.ts` and `sdui-parser/src/types.ts` |
| F3 | doctor declares `DiagnosticLevel` again | `DiagnosticLevel — a NEW colliding name`: `doctor.ts` and `flow-sim-types.ts` |
| control | unmutated | `Tests 11 passed (11)` |

The first S1 to S3 run was a no-op, and `ablation-replace` refused it. That run's replacements re-inserted the anchor line, so the anchor count did not drop. The tool restored each file and exited non-zero before running the gate. The legs were re-run with anchors that the mutation replaces, and the readings above are from that re-run.

## Acceptance notes

- **The flow designer's `DiagnosticLevel` is not renamed.** Only the doctor's is. The reason is above: the flow level types server and expression problems too.
- **JSDoc on the renamed declarations.** `FlowSimDiagnostic`, `DoctorDiagnostic` and `DesignerConfirmDialogState` each gain a short doc comment. It says why the type is not spelled with the general name, so the next author does not restore it.
- **Two lines beyond the riders' named ones, in the same comment blocks.** `chatMessageAdapter.ts`'s lead-in now reads "Two chat-message types meet", where it said "Two `ChatMessage` types meet". The first line of `useObjectChat.ts`'s comment now says "the runtime `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`".
- **A correction to batch 5's note.** That note said the stale `AiChatPage.tsx` sentence ships in app-shell's built JS. The base dist does not show that: `AiChatPage.js` holds 0 hits of "deprecated alias" or "should spell". The comment sits on a type-only import specifier, which `tsc` elides, so this rider is source-only.
- **`hooks/index.ts` is still unreachable.** `packages/plugin-designer/src/hooks/index.ts` has 0 importers, as batch 5 noted. This PR only renames its re-export.
- **One vocabulary, two names.** The flow designer's `DiagnosticLevel` and sdui-parser's `Severity` are both `'error' | 'warning'` under different names. That is not a collision under the gate. It is noted here and not filed.
